title: 无基质的角色：LLM个体化问题的体制依赖性
summary: 本文通过实验揭示LLM中角色向量在不同干预方式（提示、微调、推理时引导）下不具有共指性，提出“体制索引个体化”框架，认为表征内容的身份单元是（载体，体制）对，而非单独载体。
summary_en: This paper reveals through experiments that persona vectors in LLMs lack co-reference across different regimes (prompting, fine-tuning, inference-time steering), proposing a regime-indexed individuation framework where the identity unit is a (vehicle, regime) pair.
